                if (stringList != null && index < stringList.Length)
                {
                    result[i] = stringList[index];
                }
                else
                {
                    // vpkstuff patch: one interned placeholder; a new string per 4-byte index built
                    // about 36 times the input (16 MB of indices made 579 MB).
                    result[i] = "<INVALID: string not in DATA string list>";
                }
